_comment: The repos you actually have installed, keyed by GitHub full_name. Copy this to starred_installed.json and edit. Each entry is EITHER a version_cmd Wren runs to read the version, OR a static version you maintain by hand. Only repos listed here get an 'Installed' column on /starred. Delete the _comment key. A command not on the launchd PATH (see the plist) can be an absolute path.
